text:
carmen-eng: heads up — ran the onboarding sampleapp and found a surprising opt-bleed on retries. we validate tool outputs with strict schema on first attempt, but after a 401-triggered retry the helper accepted extra fields.

ben-devex: can you paste a tiny repro + logs?

carmen-eng: minimal repro below. sdk created with explicit opts, but retry path calls factory without reusing them.
```js
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, schema: profileSchema, helperFactory: makeHelper });
await client.callTool('getProfile', payload); // simulate 401 -> retry -> helper = makeHelper() // factory reads process.env and returns strictSchema:false
```
logs: first attempt -> schema.reject extra_field; retry -> accepted extra_field -> downstream fncall parse error.

io-qa: we got a similar report from a customer yesterday. final payload arrived as a permissive object and broke type-dependent UI code.

ben-devex: thinking out loud: cause is retry path re-instantiating helper via factory that defaults to env-derived opts. quick fix: RetryClient should shallow-clone and thread the original helper options (strictSchema, jsonMode, schema) into retry attempts. low-risk and reversible.

carmen-eng: agreed. secondary measures: 1) add a samplekit lint that flags helperFactory implementations that touch process.env for default opts; 2) add an invariant e2e that forces a 401 on first attempt and asserts schema enforcement still happens on final response; 3) docs note in SDK helpers explaining the retry lifecycle and opt preservation.

io-qa: +1 on all. for the e2e, also run with DEFAULT_STRICT=true and DEFAULT_STRICT=false to catch env-default differences. put it in the lightweight gate so it runs pre-merge.

ben-devex: plan: open PR that contains a) RetryClient change to preserve opts b) unit tests for RetryClient that simulate auth 401 c) samplekit e2e that simulates 401 and checks schema rejection d) a small ESLint rule in samplekit repo that warns when helperFactory reads process.env for strict/json defaults e) a short docs blurb under SDK helpers about "preserve helper options across retries". I'll include test coverage and a changelog note.

ci-bot: samplekit pipeline: flaky test detected, will re-run jobs on PR.

carmen-eng: can you include a tiny example of a safe factory in the docs? e.g. `const makeHelper = (opts = {}) => ({ jsonMode: true, strictSchema: true, ...opts });` so teams call `makeHelper(originalOpts)` on retry.

io-qa: i'll add the invariant e2e and a test matrix entry. we'll canary on dedicated after the PR merges.

ben-devex: PR number will be referenced here when ready, tagging @io-qa for test signoff. thanks all — quick patch should close this. :thumbsup:
